RECORD_LEDE:
Nearly three years of coffee in the Dubai office, and a fair question: what are we doing differently now?

In case we have never properly explained ourselves: NoFilter is a coffee company that exists to keep rainforest standing. We buy from NGO-led conservation projects on the forest edge in Sumatra, where teams like SRI and PRCF work the same ground as the growers, and a share of what you spend on coffee goes straight back into that work.

You are already part of it. Since January the Dubai office has been drinking coffee from Batang Toru and Batang Gadis — two forest-edge origins in North Sumatra, each with its own growers and its own mill, where communities are paid to hold the line against clearing rather than to clear. NoFilter customers paid for drying houses and milling equipment so those growers could process and export their own coffee instead of selling it on as raw cherry.

That is the switch. Part two is what we build on top of it:
